title: Extraordinary Fermented Chinese Double-Rise-Bread Kung Pao-Style Stew
description: A fermented, gooey, monsoon Chinese dish featuring white bread mix, double-rise-bread, paleo-friendly, in a classic Kung Pao style, cooked in a traditional tagine pot.

ingredients.name: Vegetable oil
ingredients.notes: or peanut oil for added flavor

instructions: Combine white bread mix, double-rise-bread, and water in a large bowl to form a sticky dough.
Knead the dough for 10 minutes until smooth and elastic.
Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover it with plastic wrap, and let it rise in a warm place for 1 hour.
Preheat the tagine pot over medium heat.
Add the Kung Pao sauce, soy sauce, and vegetable oil to the tagine pot.
Stir-fry the sauce ingredients for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the fermented dough to the sauce and stir-fry for another 2 minutes until combined.
Transfer the stew to a serving bowl, garnish with scallions and cilantro, and serve warm.
Let the stew rest for 10 minutes to allow the flavors to meld together.
